capabilities: Publish notes to WeChat Official Account drafts
Apply designer themes with fully inlined CSS
Compress and upload local and external images to the WeChat CDN
Preview the article in a phone frame with link and sensitive-word checks
Overwrite the previously created draft instead of making duplicates
disambiguation: Not a general static-site or Obsidian Publish tool; it only sends notes to WeChat Official Account drafts.
extras: AppID/AppSecret use requires an IP allowlist; otherwise a temporary access token can be pasted. Publishing is cancelled if any image upload fails. The manifest says six themes while the README lists eleven.
problem: Moving a note into the WeChat editor normally loses its formatting and requires re-uploading every image by hand.

relations.evidence: saves them straight to your draft box

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes as styled WeChat Official Account drafts, with designer themes, automatic image upload, KaTeX math and code highlighting.
